plans.title: Plans & pricing
plans.description: What the platform sells, and what each unit of it costs to serve.

preview.note: What a buyer sees on Settings → Billing, built from the same component. Pencil adjusts a plan, + adds one. Choose and Upgrade do nothing here.
preview.error: The plans could not be loaded.
preview.dragHint: Drag a card onto another to change the order buyers see, or use ‹ ›. The switch on a card shows or hides it.
preview.reorderError: The new order could not be saved. Refresh to see the order that was kept.
preview.toggleError: {name} could not be shown or hidden.

plans.rateCardCount: {count, plural, one {# rate card} other {# rate cards}}
plans.rateCardsNote: Margins are read from the rate card's recorded multiplier. Where a price is in one currency and the provider cost in another, no margin is shown — dividing them would produce a number off by the exchange rate.
plans.errorHint: Check the billing service and that your session still holds the platform admin role.
plans.rateCardsError: Rate cards could not be loaded.
plans.configError: Pricing configuration could not be loaded.
plans.footerNote: Editable, within what the API allows. Nothing here is deleted: a plan is named on every invoice ever raised against it, so it is retired with its Active switch, and a rate card is retired with Deactivate because settled charges point at it. A new rate-card identity still arrives with the migration that registers it.

rateCardRow.marginDerivedTooltip: Computed from price and cost — both in USD
rateCardRow.marginRecordedTooltip: As recorded on the rate card

settings.title: Platform settings
settings.description: Everything the platform runs on, in the order you can act on it: the knobs you can turn, then the reference data you can only read.

bandKnobs.title: Knobs you can turn
bandKnobs.note: Saved from this page, applied platform-wide, recorded against your account.

bandReference.title: Reference data
bandReference.note: The language catalog is audited; voice consent is read-only.

settings.pricingEconomicsSubnote: The same configuration the plan validator and the rate-card margin reader consult — also reachable from Plans & pricing. Customer prices live in Stripe, so the credit value and the per-credit price floor are no longer edited here; they change by migration.
settings.meetingCreditRatesSubnote: What a meeting is charged per second. A change applies to the very next charge; usage already settled keeps the price it was charged at.
settings.voiceConsentCount: {count, plural, one {# decision recorded} other {# decisions recorded}}
settings.explainer: What you can change here, and what you cannot. The language catalog is editable: every add, rename or switch is written to the platform audit log first, and refused if it cannot be recorded, so each change has a name against it. The voice-consent ledger stays read-only — its service cannot record who changed it.
settings.footerNote: Counts only, and that is a boundary rather than a shortcut. A cloned voice is biometric data; a list of who agreed to it would be a register of biometric permissions, and nothing on this screen acts on a person.

panelError.hint: Check the service and that your session still holds the platform admin role.

billingPolicy.vatHint: Applied to every invoice the platform raises. A fraction: 0.1 is 10%.
billingPolicy.saveErrorToast: The billing policy could not be saved.

hints.TRANSLATION: Per second of source speech, for each language it is translated into.
hints.AUDIO_DUBBING_STANDARD: Per second of audio rendered with a catalog voice.
hints.AUDIO_DUBBING_VOICE_CLONE: Per second of audio rendered with the speaker's cloned voice.

meetingCreditRates.invalid: Enter a price above 0, up to {max}, with at most 6 decimals.
meetingCreditRates.saveErrorToast: The rate could not be saved.

pricingEconomics.fxRateHint: Stripe's USD→VND rate, recorded once a day; every report converts each day at that day's rate.
pricingEconomics.fxRefreshError: Could not refresh the rate from Stripe
pricingEconomics.fxOverrideAriaLabel: Override rate, VND per US dollar
pricingEconomics.cartesiaUsdPerCreditHint: What one Cartesia credit costs WarpTalk. Insights price dubbing as measured Cartesia credits × this × the FX rate. The account spends credits bought earlier, so enter what they cost, not the Free plan's marginal 0. Default: Startup plan, $49 / 1,250,000.
pricingEconomics.minimumContractPriceHint: Per cycle, before a plan is valid.
pricingEconomics.defaultInvoiceTermsHint: Days to pay, and the grace window after that, for plans that do not override them.

form.description: Room validation accepts it as soon as it is enabled. The meeting pickers in this app only offer languages the app ships; a new one shows as “renders as a code” until it does.
form.codeHint: ISO 639 language, optional region — e.g. de or de-DE.
form.genericError: Nothing was changed. The catalog was not updated, or the change could not be recorded in the audit log.

errors.codeInvalid: Use a language code like de or de-DE.
errors.codeTaken: That language is already in the catalog.
errors.codeCovered: Already covered by {code} — rooms match on the language, not the region.
errors.nameTooLong: Name must be at most 100 characters.
errors.nativeNameTooLong: Native name must be at most 100 characters.

toggle.disableDescription: Soft switch: the row stays, and past meetings keep naming it. New rooms in {code} are refused until it is enabled again.
toggle.enableDescription: New rooms in {code} will be accepted again.
toggle.blocked: {count, plural, one {# live meeting uses this language.} other {# live meetings use this language.}} It can be disabled once they end.
toggle.last: This is the only enabled language. Disabling it would stop every room from being created.
toggle.confirmUpcoming: {count, plural, one {# scheduled meeting uses this language} other {# scheduled meetings use this language}}. Anyone editing or joining it in {code} will be refused.

languageCatalog.empty: The catalog is empty — no room in any language can be created.
languageCatalog.driftTitle: {count, plural, one {The meeting picker offers # language this catalog will reject.} other {The meeting picker offers # languages this catalog will reject.}}
languageCatalog.driftBody: {names} — anyone choosing one gets “Source language is not supported.” Either seed the row or drop it from the picker.
languageCatalog.footnote: This is <code1>translation_room.supported_languages</code1>, the table room validation queries — not <code2>platform.supported_languages</code2>, which the seed script still writes and nothing validates against since migration 036.

voiceConsent.nobodyAsked: Nobody has been asked for voice consent yet.
voiceConsent.liveGrantsHeading: Live grants by the wording agreed to
voiceConsent.outdatedNotice: {count, plural, one {# live grant was} other {# live grants were}} given under wording that has since been replaced. Consent stays valid for what it said at the time — this is the count to re-ask if the change was material.

fields.name: Name
fields.sortOrderHint: Where it sits on the pricing page.
fields.activeHint: Hidden plans stay on old invoices. This is how a plan is retired — there is no delete.
fields.billingCycleHint: Monthly only — the update endpoint accepts no other value.
fields.overageCapHint: Zero means the plan allows no overage.
fields.lowBalanceHint: Must sit above the overage cap, or the warning lands after billing starts.
fields.featuresHint: The JSON blob the pricing page reads. An array or an object.
fields.overagePriceHint: What one credit costs once the allowance is used up, in {currency}.
fields.rolloverCapHint: Unused credits that carry over to the next cycle.
fields.invoiceTermsHint: How long an invoice may stay unpaid.
fields.invoiceGraceHint: How long the plan keeps working after a missed payment.

editDialog.title: Edit plan
editDialog.description: Saving replaces the whole plan. Members on it keep their subscription; the new terms apply from their next cycle.

createDialog.title: New plan
createDialog.description: Creates a catalogue entry. Nobody is subscribed to it until a subscription is moved onto it or a checkout sells it; leave it hidden to stage it.

planForm.saveError: The plan could not be saved.

vat.charged: Buyers pay {total} on Stripe ({percent}% VAT added).
vat.hint: Enter the price without VAT. The VAT rate is set in Platform settings.
vat.off: VAT is off (0% in Platform settings): buyers pay exactly this price.

presets.overageCapNone: No overage — stop at the allowance
presets.overagePriceSame: Same as the in-plan credit price

featureControls.googleMeetHint: Translate Google Meet calls through WarpTalk.
featureControls.contractBillingHint: Billed by contract; usage past the cap is invoiced.
featureControls.highlightsHint: Tick the lines to list under this plan, or add your own.

editDialog.title: Edit rate card
editDialog.description: What this unit sells for and what it costs to serve. The charge type, provider and model identify the card and cannot be retyped here — a new billing identity arrives with the migration that registers it.

fields.providerCostHint: Blank means no cost is recorded. Not the same as zero.
fields.markupHint: What the margin column reports. Blank leaves it to be derived, or left unknown.
fields.activeHint: An inactive card stops being charged against; the row stays for the invoices that used it.

preview.heading: Pricing preview
preview.hintReady: Prices one unit at this cost and markup against the stored FX rate and credit value. Publishes nothing.
preview.hintNotReady: Enter both a provider cost and a markup to preview.

errors.previewStale: Cost or markup changed since the preview. Preview again before saving.
errors.previewRequired: Preview the new pricing before saving a change to cost or markup.
errors.unitPriceInvalid: Unit price must be a positive amount.
errors.providerCostInvalid: Provider cost must be a positive amount in USD, or left blank.
errors.markupInvalid: Markup multiplier must be above zero, or left blank.
errors.saveFailed: The rate card could not be saved.
errors.previewFailed: The pricing preview could not be calculated.

creditCost.title: Provider cost
creditCost.description: What the provider charges WarpTalk per unit on a credit-unit (CRD) card — the card usage is actually settled on. Its credit price is set separately and does not change here. Admin Insights reads this cost to compute AI provider cost.
creditCost.hint: In USD for one {unit} of usage, as the provider bills it. Must be above zero.
creditCost.effectBackfill: This card has no provider cost yet. The value will also apply to the usage already settled on it, so past periods in Insights gain a cost.
creditCost.effectSupersede: This card already has a cost. A new version of the card takes effect now; usage already settled keeps the cost that applied to it.

errors.invalid: Enter a positive amount in USD, for example 0.00049.
errors.noUnit: This card has no unit, so a per-unit cost cannot be applied to it.

deactivate.title: Deactivate this rate card?
deactivate.description: It stops pricing new usage now and leaves this list — it cannot be reactivated from this screen. Usage that resolves to it is not charged until a new rate is published for the identity. The row itself stays, because settled charges point at it.
deactivate.error: The rate card could not be deactivated.

dialog.title: Edit pricing configuration
dialog.description: Platform-wide. These are the floors and rates every plan is validated against and every quote is built from, so a change here can make an existing plan invalid on its next edit.

fxRateUsdVnd.label: FX rate USD→VND
fxRateUsdVnd.hint: How a USD provider cost is read in VND.

cartesiaUsdPerCredit.label: Cartesia USD per credit
cartesiaUsdPerCredit.hint: Measured Cartesia credits × this × FX is the dubbing cost in Insights. Leave blank to keep the stored value.

config.saveError: The pricing configuration could not be saved.
